Write a template database and model

Source: R/io_data.R
lexio_template.Rd

Copies to dir the 3-sector example database, in the format read by read_io(), and a commented model.yml. Replace the values with those of your own database: the number of sectors and of satellite accounts comes from the files.

Usage

lexio_template(dir, format = c("csv", "xlsx"))

Arguments

dir

Destination folder (must not exist).

format

"csv" (a folder of CSV files) or "xlsx" (one workbook with the sheets sectors, Z, x, f, E and corridor).

Value

dir, invisibly.
